entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. This whole process is a joke. I want my money back, now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference?
Are you serious? There's nothing wrong with it, I just changed my mind! It was a stupid impulse buy and I just don't use it. This shouldn't be so complicated. I want a refund!
Okay, I understand. So it's not a defect, you'd just prefer not to keep the item. Can I have your order number please?

It's VF-99812. And don't you dare try to tell me I have to sell it on some second-hand resale site. I paid VeloFit, I expect VeloFit to refund me. If you give me any trouble, I'll be sure to post about this experience everywhere. I want to speak to your manager!

I understand your frustration, sir, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. Let me just pull up your order. VF-99812... okay, I see it here. The VeloBand Pulse was delivered 18 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
You'd better. This is ridiculous. Eighteen days, ninety days, who cares? Just process the return.

Okay, one moment... Yes, I'm looking at our knowledge base right here, and it states all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 18, you are well within that timeframe. I can process this for you right away.
Oh. So you're doing it then? No problem?

Yes, absolutely. No problem at all. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you now, and it will be sent to the email address on file. Just put the device back in its original box, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Fine. And I get a full refund?
Correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 5-7 business days.
Okay. Good. That's what I expected in the first place.
I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
